samples.original_text: For a cross-border payment, identify the recipient's legal form and tax residence, the payer, the nature and source of the income, where services are performed, whether a Moldovan permanent establishment is involved, and the relevant tax treaty. Moldova's Fiscal Code lists categories of Moldova-source income earned by nonresidents. The list includes specified service income, interest, royalties, rent or use of Moldovan property, employment and other enumerated income. Some service categories have different territorial tests: SFS says specified Article 71(1)(b) services can be Moldova-source even when performed abroad, while the residual services in paragraph (b¹) are source income when performed in Moldova.
